facts.fact: SimoCash, an app launched in May 2026, is said to carry instant cross-border transfers across Cote d'Ivoire, Senegal, Mali, Togo, Burkina Faso and Benin.

CIV.note: No government payment to people is stated.
No survey share of adults is given.

facts.fact: SimoCash, launched in May 2026, carries payments and money transfers over mobile money networks such as Orange Money in Cote d'Ivoire.
The article says SimoCash lets funds move directly from one mobile money operator to another, Orange Money being named as one.

CIV.note: Bill payments named are utilities, TV and transport, not state revenue.
